description: This file defines the EncryptionManager class responsible for encrypting, decrypting, and deleting files using Android's security cryptography libraries, with a focus on managing encrypted data storage within an Android app.

classes.name: EncryptionManager
classes.description: A class providing methods for encrypting, decrypting, and deleting files using Android's encrypted file APIs with a master key.

methods.name: encryptString
methods.description: Encrypts a plaintext string and writes it to a specified file within the app's internal storage.

methods.name: decryptString
methods.description: Reads an encrypted file and decrypts its contents into a plaintext string.

methods.name: deleteEncryptedFile
methods.description: Deletes an encrypted file given its filename.
